cgltf — single-file glTF 2.0 parser (C99)

Upstream:  https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf
Version:   1.14   (tag v1.14)
File:      cgltf.h  (vendored verbatim, byte-for-byte; DO NOT edit)
Fetched:   2026-06-08
License:   MIT (notice at the end of cgltf.h)

Why vendored (not fetched at build time): cgltf is a single public-domain-
style MIT header. Vendoring it keeps the build hermetic and network-free
(CLAUDE.md: "No network access during build beyond the initial dependency
fetch"). Re-sync by replacing cgltf.h with a newer tagged release and bumping
the Version line above — keep it pristine so the diff against upstream stays
trivial. CGLTF_IMPLEMENTATION is defined in exactly one translation unit
(openjfx_model3d_bridge.cpp); this header is compiled there.
